scenarios.reason: NOT-DETERMINISTIC, not attempted: DOC answers DOC-409-CHECK-ENDED only when INT's status read (RPT, AWAITING_DOCUMENTS) precedes the Check's ending AND DOC's Ended-Check marker is committed before DOC's handover step 1a. Every ending path (CheckEndingService, start-up recovery) commits the RPT status first and records DOC's marker after that commit, and the multipart body is parsed before UploadService reads the status (resolve-lazily, argument resolution), so nothing an HTTP client controls can hold a request between INT's read and DOC's check. Only a thread-level test (a test double pausing between the two) reproduces it — out of scope for this API-only runner
